plain: Mario Woods, a former Air Force man who says he and fellow airmen were taken by aliens, tells on Jesse Michels' podcast about an earlier case he heard of. According to him, sometime before 1977, near the town of Wall, South Dakota, in a military area called Echo, two guards responded to a call at a site and were later found nearly naked. He tells it as a sign that strange things were already happening around those military sites before his own experience.
